pattern_explanation: These words look very similar to English words, so a learner may guess their meaning from the spelling. The look-alike English words have different meanings, which is why the match has to be learned rather than guessed.
false_friend_warning: Be careful: several Portuguese words look like English words but mean something else. The English words soap, academy, library and fabric are false friends for the Portuguese words that mean soup, gym, bookstore and factory.
